premise: There isn't a breath of wind: the sailboat can't sail, Lola's kite won't fly, and Gull won't bother; when the wind comes it fills the sails and lifts the kite.
inspiration: Aesop's North Wind fable seen from the other side: everyone waits for the wind, and it gives each of them what they need.
lesson: Good things can be worth waiting for.
learning: A sail catches the wind, and the wind pushes the boat along.

en-US.title: Waiting for the Wind
en-US.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2} Not a breath of wind. {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} The sailboat sat still on the flat blue sea, its white sails hanging down. {sailboat:pulse} {girl:enter} Lola stood and waited. {girl:face sad} {girl:says} [sad] "Come on, wind." {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to sand} Gull sat on the sand, {seagull:face sleeping} not even bothering to fly. [short pause] Then… a ripple. A flutter. {canvas:wind 0.7 25s} {sfx:breeze} Whoosh! Here came the wind! {sailboat:live sails} The sails puffed out, round and full. {girl:face surprised} {girl:live point} {girl:says} [excited] "Look! The wind's pushing the sail!" {girl:face happy} {girl:live kite hold} Lola let out the string, and up went her kite. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:go to girl kite} Gull woke up and flew up beside the kite. {sailboat:go to sea right} And off went the sailboat across the bay, pushed along by the wind. [happily] Wind for the boat, wind for the kite, wind under Gull's wings. {girl:hearts} Everyone had been waiting for the very same thing.

es-ES.title: Esperando al viento
es-ES.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2} Ni una pizca de viento. {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} El velero estaba quieto en el mar azul y liso, con las velas blancas colgando. {sailboat:pulse} {girl:enter} Lola esperaba y esperaba. {girl:face sad} {girl:says} [sad] «Venga, viento.» {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to sand} Gaviota estaba sentada en la arena, {seagull:face sleeping} sin ganas ni de volar. [short pause] Entonces… una ondita. Un aleteo. {canvas:wind 0.7 25s} {sfx:breeze} ¡Fiuuu! ¡Ya llegaba el viento! {sailboat:live sails} Las velas se hincharon, redondas y llenas. {girl:face surprised} {girl:live point} {girl:says} [excited] «¡Mira! ¡El viento empuja la vela!» {girl:face happy} {girl:live kite hold} Lola soltó hilo, y arriba subió su cometa. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:go to girl kite} Gaviota se despertó y subió volando junto a la cometa. {sailboat:go to sea right} Y el velero cruzó la bahía, empujado por el viento. [happily] Viento para el barco, viento para la cometa, viento bajo las alas de Gaviota. {girl:hearts} Todos estaban esperando lo mismo.

ja-JP.title: 風を まって
ja-JP.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2}風が、そよりともふきません。{sailboat:enter}{sailboat:go to sea}ヨットは、たいらな青い海の上で、じっとしたまま。白い帆も、だらーん。{sailboat:pulse}{girl:enter}ローラは、立ったまま、まっていました。{girl:face sad}{girl:says}[sad]「風さん、ふいてよ…」 {seagull:enter}{seagull:go to sand}カモメさんは、砂の上にすわりこんで、{seagull:face sleeping}とぶ気も、ありません。[short pause]そのとき…水が、さわっ。なにかが、ひらっ。{canvas:wind 0.7 25s}{sfx:breeze}びゅうーん！風がきた！{sailboat:live sails}帆が、まあるく、ぱんぱんにふくらみました。{girl:face surprised}{girl:live point}{girl:says}[excited]「見て！風が、帆をおしてる！」 {girl:face happy}{girl:live kite hold}ローラが糸をのばすと、たこが、すうっと空へ。{seagull:face happy}{seagull:go to girl kite}カモメさんも目をさまして、たこのそばへ、とんでいきました。{sailboat:go to sea right}そしてヨットは、風におされて、海をすいすい、わたっていきます。[happily]ヨットに風、たこに風、カモメさんのつばさにも風。{girl:hearts}みんな、おなじものを、まっていたのです。

de-DE.title: Warten auf den Wind
de-DE.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2} Kein Lüftchen regte sich. {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} Das Segelboot lag still auf dem glatten blauen Meer, und die weißen Segel hingen schlaff herunter. {sailboat:pulse} {girl:enter} Lola stand da und wartete. {girl:face sad} {girl:says} [sad] „Komm schon, Wind.“ {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to sand} Die Möwe saß im Sand {seagull:face sleeping} und hatte nicht mal Lust zu fliegen. [short pause] Dann… ein Kräuseln. Ein Flattern. {canvas:wind 0.7 25s} {sfx:breeze} Huiii! Da kam der Wind! {sailboat:live sails} Die Segel blähten sich auf, rund und prall. {girl:face surprised} {girl:live point} {girl:says} [excited] „Schau mal! Der Wind schiebt das Segel!“ {girl:face happy} {girl:live kite hold} Lola ließ die Schnur abrollen, und hoch stieg ihr Drachen. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:go to girl kite} Die Möwe wachte auf und flog hinauf zum Drachen. {sailboat:go to sea right} Und das Segelboot sauste davon, quer über die Bucht, vom Wind geschoben. [happily] Wind fürs Boot, Wind für den Drachen, Wind unter den Flügeln der Möwe. {girl:hearts} Alle hatten auf genau dasselbe gewartet.

fr-FR.title: En attendant le vent
fr-FR.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2} Pas un souffle de vent. {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} Le voilier restait immobile sur la mer toute plate, toute bleue, ses voiles blanches pendantes. {sailboat:pulse} {girl:enter} Lola attendait, attendait. {girl:face sad} {girl:says} [sad] « Allez, le vent… » {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to sand} Mouette était assise sur le sable, {seagull:face sleeping} sans même avoir envie de voler. [short pause] Et puis… une ride sur l’eau. Un frisson. {canvas:wind 0.7 25s} {sfx:breeze} Fiou ! Voilà le vent ! {sailboat:live sails} Les voiles se sont gonflées, bien rondes. {girl:face surprised} {girl:live point} {girl:says} [excited] « Regardez ! Le vent pousse la voile ! » {girl:face happy} {girl:live kite hold} Lola a déroulé la ficelle, et son cerf-volant est monté dans le ciel. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:go to girl kite} Mouette s’est réveillée, et elle s’est envolée tout près du cerf-volant. {sailboat:go to sea right} Et le voilier est parti à travers la baie, poussé par le vent. [happily] Du vent pour le bateau, du vent pour le cerf-volant, du vent sous les ailes de Mouette. {girl:hearts} Tout le monde attendait exactement la même chose !

it-IT.title: Aspettando il vento
it-IT.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2} Neanche un filo di vento. {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} La barca a vela era ferma sul mare liscio e blu, con le vele bianche che pendevano giù. {sailboat:pulse} {girl:enter} Lola aspettava, aspettava. {girl:face sad} {girl:says} [sad] «Forza, vento, vieni.» {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to sand} Gabbiano se ne stava sulla sabbia, {seagull:face sleeping} senza nemmeno voglia di volare. [short pause] Poi… un brivido sull'acqua. Un fruscio. {canvas:wind 0.7 25s} {sfx:breeze} Fiuuu! Ecco che arriva il vento! {sailboat:live sails} Le vele si sono gonfiate, belle tonde e piene. {girl:face surprised} {girl:live point} {girl:says} [excited] «Guarda! Il vento spinge la vela!» {girl:face happy} {girl:live kite hold} Lola ha lasciato andare il filo, e l'aquilone è salito in alto. {seagull:face happy} {seagull:go to girl kite} Gabbiano si è svegliato ed è volato su, accanto all'aquilone. {sailboat:go to sea right} E la barca a vela è partita attraverso la baia, spinta dal vento. [happily] Vento per la barca, vento per l'aquilone, vento sotto le ali di Gabbiano. {girl:hearts} Tutti stavano aspettando proprio la stessa cosa.

zh-TW.title: 等風來
zh-TW.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2}一點點風也沒有。{sailboat:enter}{sailboat:go to sea}帆船停在平平的藍色海面上，動也不動，白白的帆垂了下來。{sailboat:pulse}{girl:enter}蘿拉站著，等呀等。{girl:face sad}{girl:says}[sad]「風啊，快來嘛。」 {seagull:enter}{seagull:go to sand}海鷗坐在沙灘上，{seagull:face sleeping}懶得連飛都不想飛。[short pause]然後……水面皺了一下。帆抖了一下。{canvas:wind 0.7 25s}{sfx:breeze}呼——！風來了！{sailboat:live sails}帆一下子鼓起來，圓圓的、飽飽的。{girl:face surprised}{girl:live point}{girl:says}[excited]「你看！風在推帆耶！」 {girl:face happy}{girl:live kite hold}蘿拉把線放長，她的風箏飛上天了。{seagull:face happy}{seagull:go to girl kite}海鷗醒過來，飛到風箏旁邊。{sailboat:go to sea right}帆船也出發了，被風推著，滑過海灣。[happily]風推著帆船，風托著風箏，風也托著海鷗的翅膀。{girl:hearts}原來大家等的，都是同一陣風。

zh-HK.title: 等風來
zh-HK.text: {sailboat:float loop 0.2}一點風也沒有。{sailboat:enter}{sailboat:go to sea}帆船靜靜地停在平平的藍色海面上，白帆垂了下來。{sailboat:pulse}{girl:enter}蘿拉站着，等呀等。{girl:face sad}{girl:says}[sad]「風呀，快啲嚟啦。」 {seagull:enter}{seagull:go to sand}海鷗坐在沙灘上，{seagull:face sleeping}連飛也懶得飛。[short pause]然後……水面起了一點點漣漪。帆輕輕動了一下。{canvas:wind 0.7 25s}{sfx:breeze}呼——！風來了！{sailboat:live sails}帆鼓了起來，又圓又飽。{girl:face surprised}{girl:live point}{girl:says}[excited]「睇吓！風推住個帆呀！」 {girl:face happy}{girl:live kite hold}蘿拉把線放長，她的風箏飛上了天。{seagull:face happy}{seagull:go to girl kite}海鷗醒過來，飛呀飛，飛到風箏旁邊。{sailboat:go to sea right}帆船被風推着，在海灣上越駛越遠。[happily]風，推着小船；風，托起風箏；風，在海鷗的翅膀底下。{girl:hearts}原來，大家等的都是同一樣東西。

breeze.prompt: a sea breeze rising and filling sails, cloth flapping and snapping taut, realistic field recording
